branch: main (no worktree; nothing is pushed until the ship step)
project_type: Static site generator + static client + scheduled data fetch. Plain Node 24 ESM, zero runtime framework, no bundler. Output in dist/ (gitignored; GitHub Pages deploys dist/ from the workflow).
language: JavaScript (ESM, Node v24.16.0), CSS, HTML; Python only for scripts/audit.py (Playwright) run through the workspace venv
build_system: npm scripts only. `npm run build` = node scripts/build.mjs (content/roadmap.md → dist/). Dependencies allowed: markdown-it 14.1.0 (exact) and fast-xml-parser 5.11.2 (exact). .npmrc save-exact=true. Disk: 3.95 GB free on C: — node_modules must stay under ~5 MB; nothing else gets installed.
test_framework: node:test via `npm test` = node --test "tests/**/*.test.js". Tests never touch the network: feed tests use recorded fixtures in tests/fixtures/feed/ (byte-exact, .gitattributes -text); build tests read content/roadmap.md (a local file) and hand-written snippets in tests/fixtures/md/. Pure client modules live in assets/lib/*.js (no DOM access) so node:test imports them directly.
verify_command: npm run verify  (= node scripts/verify.mjs: spawns scripts/serve.mjs on the first free port 8790–8799, waits for 200, crawls internal links + fragments, runs scripts/audit.py with c:/Users/sudiskmr/Downloads/DomainClassification/.venv/Scripts/python.exe, writes docs/verify-report.json, kills the server, exits 1 on any threshold failure). Flags: --pages (default index,s03,s12,s15,appendix-a,plan,feed), --all, --widths, --themes, --shots <prefix>, --live <url>, --no-external, --report. Exists from FEAT-002; completed in FEAT-007.
verification_instructions: Before every FEAT commit: (1) npm test green; (2) npm run build prints the summary line (pages 28 · chips 127 · manifest 7/10/36/12/14/26/9/24/24/8 …); (3) npm run verify green for the 7 page types × 320/360/390/820/1024/1440/1920/2560 × light/dark plus this FEAT's audit group; (4) fix ANY hard-UI-rule violation on ANY page (in scope or not) and report it; (5) status.md row updated, FEAT JSON status completed + findings written; (6) commit body lists the commands run and their results. Browser: chromium.launch(channel="msedge", headless=True, args=["--disable-lcd-text"]); new_context(viewport=…, device_scale_factor=1 (0.75 for 2560), reduced_motion="reduce"); sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"); screenshots viewport-only; one image per tool call; check pixel dimensions (Add-Type System.Drawing) before opening; never open an image >1920 px per side.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated and gitignored. Committed generated files: data/feed.json and data/meta.json (written by node scripts/fetch.mjs; refreshed by the workflow as github-actions[bot]), docs/verify-report.json and docs/screenshots/*.png (written by npm run verify -- --shots). content/SOURCE.md is rewritten by npm run sync-content.
environment_constraints: Windows 11, PowerShell 5.1: use `;` never `&&`; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue' before Invoke-WebRequest (-UseBasicParsing); never edit UTF-8 files with Get-Content/Set-Content (editor tools or a Python script only); absolute paths. Scratch files only in $env:TEMP and removed afterwards; never create temp files in the repo. Git: identity comes from ~/.gitconfig includeIf — never -c user.*, never a repo-local identity; git --no-pager; $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0'; never push before the ship step; never force-push; commit only files the FEAT owns (plus a hard-UI-rule fix anywhere, reported). A tool output cut off with ^C is an unknown outcome: inspect state before retrying anything non-idempotent. Parallel tool batches race: never run/read a file in the same batch as the edit that changes it. No secrets exist or are needed; redact key=/Authorization in any logged error. Live URL will be https://sudish007.github.io/physical-ai-roadmap/ so every asset/data/link path is relative (404.html's <base href="/physical-ai-roadmap/"> is the single exception).
contribution_requirements: One commit per FEAT with the prefix feat(FEAT-00N): and the exact message in the FEAT file; D1–D11 are binding and not reviewable; content/roadmap.md is never edited except §N cross-reference links and heading ids (fix the renderer, not the content); no gradients/shadows/animations/emoji/stock art; light is the first paint; no 'verified' as a site descriptor; no self-referential blurbs; every label becomes a chip; no invented numbers; tests offline; docs tracked under .agents/.
key_patterns: Build: markdown-it 14.1.0 instance in src/build/md.js with core rules (crossref, labels over inline text tokens) and renderer overrides (table_open/td_open/link_open/heading_open); every HTML string goes through the escaping tagged template in src/build/templates.js; the inline theme-bootstrap script is ONE string constant whose sha256 is emitted in the CSP meta; no style attributes anywhere (tables carry data-cols; bars sized by JS CSSOM). Tracker ids `<section slug>:<table slug>:<row key>` declared in src/build/content-map.mjs with per-set key rules (plan.md Decision 14). Client: ES modules loaded by assets/app.js dispatching on body[data-page]; storage through assets/lib/store.js versioned keys physical-ai-roadmap.v1.{theme,tracker,plan,triage,readpos}; the single 'Last updated' derivation is assets/lib/format.js formatLastUpdated. Feed: sources.config.mjs registry (one object literal per source) → src/feed/pipeline.js with an injected fetchImpl (Ahead's http.js pattern: browser-like headers, manual redirects, one retry, body cap, redactKey, errorSummary ≤120 chars) → data/feed.json + data/meta.json (status ok|empty|failed, error ≤120 chars, checkedAt, note, unavailableSince). Audit: scripts/audit.py has a generic section plus GROUPS[page] functions appended per FEAT.
relevant_files: content/roadmap.md (single source of truth, never reworded)
